name: Regular I Counter Left
purpose: Misdirection off the toss. We show them the toss to the Z side, their linebackers chase, and the tailback plants and comes back weak behind a pulling guard.

Z.rule: Take one hard step upfield like the toss is coming, then come back and cut off the backside.

QB.rule: Take the snap, fake the toss the other way with both hands, then turn back and hand to the tailback. The fake comes first — the handoff is late on purpose.

FB.sell: Run the toss path to the other side at full speed and block anything that shows. You are the lie.

TB.rule: Take two hard steps toward the toss, then plant and come back behind the pulling guard. Those two steps are the entire play.

coaching_points: Do not call this until I Toss Right has gone for real yards. Misdirection off a play they do not fear is just a slower run.
The tailback's counter steps must be full speed and full length. A shuffle fools nobody.
The fullback selling the toss matters more than his block. Tell him he is the decoy and mean it.
If their backside linebacker stops chasing the toss, go back to I Slant Left.
